packageRules.description: Routine (non-security) updates for npm/yarn, Dockerfile, and GitHub Actions are already handled by Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yaml). Disable Renovate's regular PRs for these managers to avoid duplicate/competing PRs. Security-vulnerability PRs still get through via vulnerabilityAlerts above, which bypasses this.
Never auto-merge major (breaking) version bumps - always require manual review.
Group minor and patch updates together per manager to reduce PR noise for anything Renovate actively manages.
Auto-merge only patch-level and lockfile-maintenance updates, and only once required status checks pass.
